name: sustainability-engagement
description: Scaffold-HBAR template for discovering Sustainability Atlas projects and recording auditable project selections with Hedera Consensus Service.

sections.title: Next steps

steps.label: Configure Sustainability Atlas and Hedera credentials

sections.text: Add your Sustainability Atlas API key, Hedera testnet account credentials, and HCS topic ID to packages/nextjs/.env.local. See README.md for setup, security, and testnet verification instructions.
